subject: PO field requirements, payment routing, and proposed invoice cadence
messages:
From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@novixa.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novixa.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: PO data fields + invoice cadence for pilot contract

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — Novixa's procurement team is ready to move forward with a pilot but we need to lock down how POs and invoices will be handled on our side. A few ask items from procurement (attached a PO template that we use):

- Our AP system requires a PO header value in the format: NOVIXA-<ENTITY>-PO-<ID> populated in the PO_NUMBER field.
- We need a payment_routing field to indicate the receiving ledger (e.g., FIN-NE/US-ACCT-01).
- Invoices must include the following extra columns: cost_center, legal_entity_id, and billing_contact_id (examples in template).
- Preferred net terms for pilots are Net 45, but we can accept Net 30 with a 1% early-payment discount if Redwood can support it.
- Invoice cadence: our default is monthly statements, but billing teams sometimes request weekly sub-invoices for multi-entity buys. Can Redwood produce monthly statements with optional weekly sub-batches?

We attached our PO template (Novixa_PO_Template_20270915.pdf) and included an example PO (Novixa_PO_45321.pdf). Also attaching a short CSV with the required invoice fields.

What's feasible on Redwood's side without custom engineering? We need to confirm before procurement raises the official PO.

Thanks,
Emily Torres
Director, Procurement
Novixa Health

Attachments: Novixa_PO_Template_20270915.pdf (application/pdf), Novixa_PO_45321.pdf (application/pdf), invoice_field_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@novixa.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 17:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: PO data fields + invoice cadence for pilot contract

Hi Emily — appreciate the clear template and examples. Looping in Vanessa (billing ops) and Ben (account exec) so we can align commercial and technical constraints.

Short answers up front:
- PO header format: we can accept any alphanumeric string in PO_NUMBER and pass it through to invoices as-is. You should be able to use NOVIXA-<ENTITY>-PO-<ID> without issue.
- payment_routing field: we support an optional freeform payment_routing field on our invoice payload; we can emit it if the field is present on the incoming PO or in the purchase metadata.
- Extra invoice columns (cost_center, legal_entity_id, billing_contact_id): we can include these as invoice-level metadata mapped from PO lines or PO header, but we need a mapping table (attached redwood_invoice_fields.csv) showing where each PO field will appear in your template.
- Invoice cadence: our hosted billing can generate a single monthly statement and also publish weekly invoice artifacts (sub-invoices) if requested. The weekly sub-batches will be separate invoice IDs tied to the monthly statement. This supports your AP team's requirement.

Questions / constraints:
1) If you prefer Net 45 we can accept that, but our standard pilot terms are Net 30. Net 45 will require a small commercial uplift (we typically apply a 0.75% surcharge).
2) Early-payment discount: we can support a 1% discount for Net 15 as a billing rule, but the discount must be agreed in the SOW/contract or an addendum so it flows into our billing automation.
3) PO parsing: to automate mapping we need either: (a) a consistent PO JSON/CSV feed from your ERP, or (b) a predictable positioning of the fields in the PDF you sent. If (a) is possible, onboarding will be faster.

Next steps: Ben, can you pick the pricing option (Net30 or Net45 + uplift) and I'll get Vanessa to confirm the invoice export format and send the mapping CSV back. Emily — if you can share an ERP export (sample) it will speed mapping.

Regards,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_invoice_fields.csv (text/csv)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@novixa.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 18:33:00 +0000
Subject: Re: PO data fields + invoice cadence for pilot contract

Emily — thanks for the template. A couple of operational notes from billing ops that will determine how we implement the mapping: 

- We can emit cost_center, legal_entity_id, and billing_contact_id at either the invoice header or per-line. If Novixa needs per-line attribution (different cost centers per line) we will need PO lines to contain explicit cost_center values.
- For payment_routing, please confirm whether your AP team expects a GL routing code or a full bank-account reference. We treat payment_routing as informational metadata on our invoices; settlement will still route to Redwood's bank account unless a separate arrangement / lockbox is set up.
- Invoice cadence compromise we often use: monthly statement generated on the 1st of the month covering the previous month, with the option of weekly sub-invoices that are flagged as 'statement-part' and reconcile to the monthly statement. That covers most ERP workflows.
- Regarding Net terms: We can approve Net 45 for the pilot if Novixa signs up for an Advance Payment Authorization (APA) — a simple one-page finance addendum — which gives us a short-term payment assurance. Without an APA, Net 45 requires the 0.75% uplift Karthik mentioned.

Operational checklist for Novixa to provide so we can automate:
1) A sample ERP PO export (CSV or SFTP drop) showing PO header + lines.
2) Clarify where NOVIXA-<ENTITY>-PO-<ID> will appear and confirm stable naming.
3) Decide whether payment_routing should be the GL code or an external bank/payment reference.
4) Who will be the billing contact email and AP mailbox for invoice delivery (we can send to a single mailbox and to your AP tool).

If you can provide the ERP sample today we can provision the mapping sandbox and run a test invoice next week. Attaching public mapping template (redwood_invoice_fields.csv) for your team to populate.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

Vanessa / Karthik — thanks for the clear summary. We can do the following to avoid the uplift:

- Novixa will sign the Advance Payment Authorization (APA) and provide a one-page finance addendum.
- We'll include the NOVIXA-<ENTITY>-PO-<ID> in the PO_NUMBER field for all POs.
- payment_routing will be the GL routing code (FIN-NE/US-ACCT-01).
- We prefer monthly statements (issued on the 1st) with weekly sub-invoices for active usage weeks; final reconciliation on the monthly statement.
- For the pilot we want Net 45 but will accept Net 30 with 1% net15 early-pay if Redwood prefers that path — but if you accept the APA we'll proceed with Net 45 and no uplift.

Attached is the signed PO (Novixa_PO_45321.pdf) and a filled mapping sheet — let us know if the CSV you attached gets populated differently. Also, please send the DocuSign agreement link for the APA and the SOW amendment.

Rob Singh
Sr. Manager, Strategic Sourcing
Novixa Health

Attachments: Novixa_PO_45321.pdf (application/pdf), Novixa_PO_Mapping_Filled.csv (text/csv)
